title: The unicorn how once in the millennium he cometh by his horn
html_source:
The third stanza of Gogarty’s “Medical Students' Song”:
The Unicorn, it appears,
Can only get a horn in a thousand years;
But when he does, he makes up for arrears –
So here’s to Copulation.

Oliver St. John Gogarty was Joyce’s inspiration for Buck Mulligan.
